code_examples.section: ltm rule command ANTIFRAUD alert guid
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ANTIFRAUD::alert_guid
       Returns GUID that is used to identify which users have been infected with malware before the user logs in.

SYNOPSIS
       ANTIFRAUD::alert_guid

DESCRIPTION
       Returns GUID that is used to identify which users have been infected with malware before the user logs in.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns GUID that is used to identify which users have been infected with malware before the user logs in.

VALID DURING
       ANTIFRAUD_ALERT

EXAMPLES
	when ANTIFRAUD_ALERT {
	    log local0. "Alert GUID: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_guid]."
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-12.0.0
		   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
